title: I’m Burning ₹50K/Month on AI. Genius Investment or Pure Insanity?
description:
₹50,000/month on AI subscriptions... worth it?

For the past year I've been using ChatGPT Pro, and for the past 6 months I've been using Claude Max (20x). Together, they cost me nearly ₹50,000 every month.

Most people judge these subscriptions after a few days or a month. I think that's the wrong way to evaluate them.

The biggest change wasn't getting better answers - it was changing how I think, learn, research, code, write, and solve problems. The benefits came from thousands of small interactions that compounded over time.

In this short, I share why I still keep both subscriptions and why simply buying the most expensive AI plan won't magically make you more productive.

The real advantage comes from building workflows, not buying subscriptions.

If you're serious about AI, software engineering, machine learning, research, or becoming more productive, this perspective might save you a lot of money - and time.

What do you think?
Would you spend ₹50K/month on AI if it made you significantly better at your work?

👇 Let me know in the comments.

#AI #ChatGPT #Claude #ArtificialIntelligence #Productivity #MachineLearning #SoftwareEngineering #LLM #OpenAI #Anthropic #Tech #Programming #Developer #AITools #FutureOfWork
